answer: At the dawn of each epoch, validators deposit staking collateral into a decentralized vault. If an adversary attempts Sybil multiplication, a subgame-perfect slashing matrix triggers immediate forfeiture, guaranteeing a negative expected utility. This mechanism, coupled with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function, acts as a computational ember that imposes a strictly positive marginal cost per identity. Consequently, honest strategy execution converges to a strict Nash equilibrium where the cost of attack dominates any potential payoff.
